description: AzureDisk represents an Azure Data Disk mount on the host and bind mount to the pod.

cachingMode.title:
Host Caching mode: None, Read Only, Read Write.
+optional

diskName.title: The Name of the data disk in the blob storage

diskURI.title: The URI the data disk in the blob storage

fsType.title:
Filesystem type to mount.
Must be a filesystem type supported by the host operating system.
Ex. "ext4", "xfs", "ntfs". Implicitly inferred to be "ext4" if unspecified.
+optional

kind.title: Expected values Shared: multiple blob disks per storage account  Dedicated: single blob disk per storage account  Managed: azure managed data disk (only in managed availability set). defaults to shared

readOnly.title:
Defaults to false (read/write). ReadOnly here will force
the ReadOnly setting in VolumeMounts.
+optional
